name: zkLink Nova Arbitrator reuses a stale transient claim hash, letting a public relayer make it call any contract
summary: zkLink Nova's L1 Arbitrator (implementation 0x7a0bb480) authenticates claimMessage by setting a transient claiming flag, calling a caller-chosen message service with caller-chosen calldata, and then requiring the transient finalizeMessageHash written by the gateway callback to match the claimed message; neither transient value is cleared, so a second claimMessage in the same transaction passes with the first claim's hash whatever its call did. SyncL2TxHashRelayer 0x0fdc28e6, a dev contract with no access control, was an active relayer and forwards any service and calldata. The attacker's contract relayed a genuine Linea syncL2TxHash claim, then relayed again with EthereumGateway.sendMessage as the 'service' call, so the Arbitrator, the gateway's trusted caller, had ZkLink.syncBatchRoot install an attacker-chosen l2LogsRootHash for batch 116409. Against that root it finalized withdrawals of 22.43 ETH from ZkLink 0x5fd9f732 and 245.74 pufETH, 12.57 ezETH, 18,113 USDC and eight other tokens from L1ERC20Bridge 0xad16edcf.
notes: Reset is the zkLink Safe 0xdb4d755e's batch 0xee6a34e8 (block 19696592, 2024-04-20), which upgraded the Arbitrator proxy to 0x7a0bb480 and set relayers[0x0fdc28e6] (slot 0x9cd81b02, mapping at slot 256) to true. The relayer was deployed two days earlier (0x15c171ec); resets.mjs shows no later change to either target.

Campaign: 0x8a7e38b9 by 0xdab137f3, an unrelated EOA, repeated the technique 999 blocks later and swept the bridge's remaining 33 token balances (mostly 216.44m ZKL, 2,132.70 GAL, 1.01 mmETH, 0.0188 uniBTC), and 0x0b9bf172 by 0xcafe3438 took 0.0025 ETH. Seven more relayer calls after the anchor (0xb54c7aea, 0xf6e1cec7, 0x84e76b89, 0x7b64c8ff, 0x8ddae31f, 0x4c2dfd53, 0x787e5393/0xd13dec76) moved no victim funds. campaign.mjs from the reset found 2,426 earlier claimMessage exercises: relayer EOAs calling the Arbitrator directly, zkLink's operator 0x3d8b52a6 relaying through 0x0fdc28e6 in April 2024 (38), and four single relays through it by 0x14a95d8c and 0x3741cd84 in blocks 25810866-25869218, each one genuine Linea claim forwarded as syncL2TxHash with no syncBatchRoot call and no victim outflow.

Loss is the gross depletion of ZkLink (ETH) and L1ERC20Bridge across the anchor and the two campaign transactions, priced by loss.mjs. ZKL is valued at what 0xdab137f3 realised (rule 12): it sold 386,411.81 ZKL for 53.94 USDC and 13.01 USDT through CoW and put 21.6m into its own Uniswap v4 position, and the remaining 216.44m could not be absorbed at the 0.000194 USD quote (41,932 USD at market). 20 balances worth under 1 USD, six of them unpriced (OMNI, two NOBL, YFTE, USDN, wUSDM), are omitted.
